title: JSON Schema collection for category 2 tasks
description: ID-based register; each task's actual validation schema is in a separate file.

conventions.purpose: The schema checks only format compliance (whether the output has the required structure). Content correctness is checked by the correctness step against the reference.
conventions.null: Every leaf field allows null, because the instruction says to set a missing field to null. Null instead of available information is a correctness error, not a format error.
conventions.required_fields: All fields named in the schema are required; a missing key is a format error.
conventions.additional_fields: additionalProperties: false. Keys outside the schema are a format error, because the instruction requires output ONLY according to the schema.
conventions.patterns: Date ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$, time ^\d{1,2}\.\d{2}$, international phone number ^\+\d{7,15}$. The pattern checks only the form; a wrong date in the right form is a correctness error.
conventions.lists: The schema does not check array length or uniqueness. These are content questions (e.g. K2-028, K2-038) and are scored in the correctness step.
conventions.allowed_values: The enum fields of K2-035 and K2-039 are a format rule: a value outside the allowed set is a format error.
conventions.validator: Ajv in draft 2020-12 mode: import Ajv2020 from 'ajv/dist/2020'. ajv-formats is not needed, because only pattern constraints are used.
